integration_requirements: Allocate before constructor for future protocols; freeze same map receipt across comparison arms; do not change running/frozen arms.
Bind final exported public bytes to independent review and execution rather than treating candidate scan as final release review.

Preserve original IDs/paper association only in controller private mapping for split/scoring/provenance; compiled outer task ID and evolution registry/feedback task IDs use opaque identity consistently.
Explicitly remap task-keyed runtime smoke configs/budgets/collection settings; reject unresolved refs, no heuristic rewrite of scientific files.
Re-run applicable runtime/compile checks on new package hash and do not carry old scientific approval.
Reject known alias residues with repair attribution; never auto-replace scientific text, filenames or source licenses.
Independent semantic review must still consider distinctive method descriptions, notices, file formats, rendered graphics and public image metadata. Binary unknown is unresolved, not pass.
limits: Known substring checks are only exact/NFKC-casefold known-identity detection, not comprehensive de-identification; encoded/compressed/semantic synonyms can evade it.
Hash binding is integrity evidence under trusted controller expectations, not a signature or OS sandbox; file checking is not an atomic adversarial snapshot.
Scientific identity can be inferable from legitimate research context even after metadata anonymization; policy-specific semantic review still required.
Module is opt-in foundation only, not integrated into production or real trial driver; no new cost or quality-success claim.

new_api.allocate_map: Fresh private allocation with secrets.token_hex(16); return hash-bound map identity, reusable across arms.
new_api.project_candidate: New copy; only tasks[].task_id changes; scientific files byte-identical, paper_id private unchanged; external receipt; source/map/link/overwrite guards.
new_api.remap_task_keys: Exact old key set only, for explicit execution budgets/collection policies; no implicit default.
new_api.scan_candidate: Full candidate public record keys/values and listed public asset paths/bytes; source locators and private paper ID are not falsely treated as public fields.
new_api.scan_release: Actual exported task.json keys/values plus manifest filenames and byte hashes; all files must be declared; known identity residues rejected.

observed_flow.observation: compile_package preserves candidate task_id in directory, outer task manifest and public TaskView. Candidate fact_id/statement/kind, full input/output contracts, public filenames and bytes are published without semantic anonymization. paper_id stays outer manifest, not public view.

check_task requires outer/public task_id equality. export_task copies only public assets to assets/<originalpath> and writes public view plus asset_manifest/release_mode. It does not export top-level private paper_id.

compile_tasks requires runtime record raw package hash/digest, budgets/collections keyed by task_id; adds controller notes. New ID package needs new runtime evidence, not transplant of old runtime record.
Actual solver release is /inputs/public/task.json plus listed public assets; hash checks provide identity integrity, not semantic leakage clearance.
Builder search_tasks and feedback use controller task IDs too; late executor-only renaming would leave another disclosure route and identity mismatches.
Candidate inventory correctly includes task_id, fact IDs, contracts, filenames and selected resources but expressly is not final compiled release certification.

scope: Read-only release-flow inspection plus new opt-in foundation and offline tests; no model invocation, no real candidate acceptance or frozen-engine modification.

coverage: real compile_package/export_task for two projected arms sharing one map
